metadata.name: IGBP
metadata.fullName: International Geosphere-Biosphere Programme Land Cover Classification
metadata.author: International Geosphere-Biosphere Programme
metadata.description: IGBP land cover classification system with 17 classes including 11 natural vegetation classes, 3 developed/mosaicked land classes, and 3 non-vegetated classes. Used in MODIS land cover products.
metadata.citation: Friedl, M., D. Sulla-Menashe, et al. MODIS Collection 5 global land cover: Algorithm refinements and characterization of new datasets. Remote Sensing of Environment, 2010.

rules.name: Woody Savannas Classification
rules.syntax: MsL'Herbaceous Growth Forms, cover 20-100%, natural or semi-natural & MsL'Woody Growth Forms, cover 30-60%, natural or semi-natural
rules.description:
Mandatory standard Layering Herbaceous Growth Forms with cover of 20-100%, natural or semi-natural
AND
Mandatory standard Layering Woody Growth Forms with cover of 30-60%, natural or semi-natural

properties.name: Woody Growth Forms Element Property Rules

metadata.author: System
metadata.notes: Woody Savannas: Herbaceous 20-100% with Woody growth forms 30-60%, natural or semi-natural

metadata.author: System
metadata.notes: Grasslands: Herbaceous growth form cover 20-100%, natural or semi-natural

rules.name: Permanent Wetlands Classification
rules.syntax: MsL'Woody Growth Forms, natural or semi-natural OR MsL'Herbaceous Growth Forms, natural or semi-natural AND MsL'Water Body, Persistence Unit Month, Persistence Period 10-12
rules.description:
Mandatory standard Layering Woody Growth Forms, natural or semi-natural
OR
Mandatory standard Layering Herbaceous Growth Forms, natural or semi-natural
AND
Mandatory standard Layering Water Body, Persistence Unit Month, Persistence Period 10-12

properties.name: Woody Growth Forms Element Property Rules
Herbaceous Growth Forms Element Property Rules

metadata.author: System
metadata.notes: Permanent Wetlands: Woody Growth Forms or Herbaceous Growth Forms, natural or semi-natural, with Water Body persistence 10-12 months

rules.name: Snow and Ice Classification
rules.syntax: Ms'Snow, Persistence Unit Month, Persistence Period 9-12 OR Ms'Ice, Persistence Unit Month, Persistence Period 9-12
rules.description:
Mandatory standard Snow, Persistence Unit Month, Persistence Period 9-12
OR
Mandatory standard Ice, Persistence Unit Month, Persistence Period 9-12

metadata.author: System
metadata.notes: Snow and Ice: Snow or Ice with persistence period 9-12 months
